name: cable kneeling high low anti rotation chop
description: A kneeling cable chop that moves from high to low while your torso resists twisting. It trains the deep core and obliques to stay stable.
instructions: Kneel side-on to a high cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Chop the handle diagonally down across your body, arms mostly straight.
Do not let your torso rotate; the arms and shoulders do the travel.
Return slowly under control, finish your reps, then switch sides.
